title: Structural MRI shows weak psychiatric prediction in 6,916 children
summary: Gradient-boosted classifier chains tested structural-MRI patterns for ten psychiatric outcomes in 6,916 children from ABCD. After accounting for sociodemographic confounding and diagnostic interdependence, ADHD and bipolar outcomes were predicted above chance, with AUROCs of 0.567 and 0.551. These small effects did not support clinical use. The observational study does not establish causal neuroanatomy or reliable individual diagnosis.
